column5: RE-MEASURED. Three of the four divergences this row listed are closed: the content column lands on 1144, the heading runs Manrope Light on the frame's ramp, and the table with its tab strip is built. The fourth stands - there is no 158x36 header CTA. Two further things on this row are settled rather than open. The three empty arms are still three and still distinct - No Creators Yet, No creators found for X, and a WifiOff Creator list unavailable the frame has no counterpart for - and keeping all three is the no-mock-data rule, not a divergence to fix. And the caveat this node carried from the oldest row, that the loader's indexer host defaults to the empty string, is stale: socialTokenService.ts reads INDEXER_URL from SKAI_INDEXER_URL, which carries a real default host.

THE TWO MEASURED MISSES THIS ROW CARRIED ARE BOTH GONE.
